newsitem.title: USA: Norcen sees 1997 spending in C$550 range.
newsitem.headline: Norcen sees 1997 spending in C$550 range.

text.p: Norcen Energy Resources Ltd expects 1997 spending would likely be in the range of or higher than 1996's C$550 million although the company does not set official capital expenditure targets, chief executive Grant Billing told a conference Friday.
Norcen also expects to bid on 30 plus Gulf of Mexico tracts in 1997, Billing said.
He added most of the bids would be on the shallow shelf although there be some deep water tracts sought.
He said the company's exploration efforts will be concentrated in North and South America. "We looked at and bid C$200 million in Peru," he said, without elaborating.

Norcen also expects to sign a definitive farm-in agreement in the next two to three weeks on the Venezuelean West Guaricho Field which is expected to be producing 5,000 to 10,000 barrels per day within two to three years, Billing said.
